data.name: Forgotten Possessions
data.detailed_description:
They say some things are better left forgotten. In this cabin, they are hunting you.

Forgotten Possessions is a raw, physics-based VR horror experience crafted by a solo developer. No hand-holding. No safety net. Just you, your flashlight, and the crushing weight of the silence.

WHY YOU WILL FEAR THE DARK:

- Ever-Changing Nightmare: Item locations and scares are randomized. Every run is a fresh descent into madness—you never know where the next item hides or where the entity will strike.

- The Guardian: A relentless AI that listens and hunts. It reacts to your noise and tracks your last known position. Silence is your only weapon.

- Unravel the Truth: Explore the cabin to find hidden collectibles and piece together a dark, forgotten history. Each run reveals more of the story.

- Scoring Mode: Beat your high score and test your stealth and survival skills in a franatical collecting run!

- Hard Story Mode: You know all the tricks and locations but want a bigger challenge? Try the unforgiving hard mode and test your skills even more!

data.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590, AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce 1070
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Seated or standing play style supported
